y-m-42-01.topic: Imeko (ubungakanani) yokuba imveliso yematrikhsi icaciswe nolandelelwano lokuphindaphinda
y-m-42-01.goal: Yazi ukuba imveliso yematrikhsi inokubalwa na imiselwa bubungakanani, hayi amaxabiso amalungu, vavanya isivakalisi esithi 'unokutshintshisa ulandelelwano' ngomzekelo ochasayo, uze wenze isigqibo jikelele semeko yokuba iimveliso zombini zenzeke.
y-m-42-01.material:
Kuphela ubungakanani beematrikhsi ezine A, B, C, D obaziwayo, kwaye amaxabiso amalungu awaziwa. ('2×3' ifundwa '2 nge-3' kwaye ithetha imiqolo emi-2 neekholam ezi-3.)
- A: 2×3
- B: 3×2
- C: 2×2
- D: 3×3
UMinjun uthe oku. "Ukuba unokubala i-AB, unokubala ne-BA ngolandelelwano olutshintshisiweyo nje. Kuba ekuphindaphindeni unokutshintshisa ulandelelwano."

y-m-42-01.thinking.2: Yenza isigqibo jikelele semeko yobungakanani apho iimveliso zombini zicaciswa khona

y-m-42-02.title: Ukufumana iimatrix ezinika isiphumo esifanayo xa ucwangciso lutshintshiselwa
y-m-42-02.topic: Ukufumana imeko apho iimatrix ezimbini zinika isiphumo esifanayo xa ucwangciso lokuphindaphinda lutshintshiselwa (2×2)
y-m-42-02.goal: Fumana iimatrix apho i-AB ne-BA zilingana ngokuhlola abagqatswa nokuthelekisa amalungu, uze uqinisekise ngemizekelo yokwenyani ukuba isisombululo asisiyo enye kuphela kodwa ziimatrix ezininzi ezanelisa imeko.
y-m-42-02.material: Kukho imatrix ye-2×2 B = [[1, 1], [0, 1]] (umgca wokuqala 1, 1 / umgca wesibini 0, 1). Kwiimatrix ezininzi A, AB no-BA ziyahluka. Umzekelo, ukuba A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]], ngoko AB = [[1, 3], [3, 7]] kunye BA = [[4, 6], [3, 4]]. Ngoku sifuna ukufumana u-A one-AB = BA. (Amanani ngamanani eqinisileyo, yaye unokuwabhala njengamanani aphelele.)

y-m-42-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iimatrix A apho AB = BA nokuba iphindaphindwa no-B ngocwangciso olutshintshiselweyo. Qala ngokufumana ezo unokunika isizathu ngazo ngaphandle kokubala.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgqatswa ngamnye, qala ubhale ukuba likho isizathu onokusinika, ngaphandle kokubala, sokuthi AB no-BA ziyalingana.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgqatswa ongenasizathu esiza engqondweni, phindaphinda ubuncinane umgca wokuqala ngokuthe ngqo uze uthelekise i-AB ne-BA.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.a: Ugwebe ukuba isiphumo sika-B no-B siyisiphumo esifanayo nokuba ucwangciso lutshintshiselwe.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.b: Oku kusenokuba lukhetho olucinge ukuba imo iyalingana ngoko ucwangciso alunamsebenzi. Phindaphinda ngokuthe ngqo uze uthelekise iziphumo ezibini.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.o.c: A = imatrix yezero O (onke amalungu angu-0)
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.c: Ugwebe ukuba isiphumo no-O sinika isiphumo esifanayo nakucwangciso nakuphi na.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.d: Oku kusenokuba lukhetho olucinge ukuba kulungile ukuba amalungu abe kwidayagonali kuphela. Hlola ukuba kunjalo nokuba amanani amabini asedayagonali ahlukile.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.r.e: Ugwebe ukuba imatrix enenani elifanayo kwidayagonali kuphela inika isiphumo esifanayo nayo nayiphi na imatrix nokuba ucwangciso luyiphi.
y-m-42-02.s.s1.explain: B ngokwayo, imatrix yezero O, ne-5E (ukuphindwa ngesiqhubekayo kwimatrix yoqobo) zinika isiphumo esifanayo nokuba ucwangciso lutshintshiselwe no-B. Kwi-[[0,1],[1,0]], AB = [[0,1],[1,1]] kunye BA = [[1,1],[1,0]], eyahlukileyo. Kwi-[[2,0],[0,3]] nako, AB = [[2,2],[0,3]] kunye BA = [[2,3],[0,3]], eyahlukileyo. Ukuba no-0 kumalungu angenanto, okanye ukuba nemo elingeneyo, akuthethi ukuba ucwangciso lunokutshintshiselwa isiphumo sihlale sifana.

M = [[0, 2, 1], [1, 0, 3], [0, 0, 0]]
